# `<sl-checkbox>` — Checkbox

Checkboxes allow the user to toggle an option on or off.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/checkbox/checkbox.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | — | `string` | `''` | — |
| `name` | — | `string` | `''` | The name of the checkbox, submitted as a name/value pair with form data. |
| `value` | — | `string` | — | The current value of the checkbox, submitted as a name/value pair with form data. |
| `size` | — | `small`, `medium`, `large` | `'medium'` | The checkbox's size. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the checkbox. |
| `checked` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the checkbox in a checked state. |
| `indeterminate` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the checkbox in an indeterminate state. This is usually applied to checkboxes that represents a "select all/none" behavior when associated checkboxes have a mix of checked and unchecked states. |
| `form` | — | `string` | `''` | By default, form controls are associated with the nearest containing `<form>` element. This attribute allows you to place the form control outside of a form and associate it with the form that has this `id`. The form must be in the same document or shadow root for this to work. |
| `required` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the checkbox a required field. |
| `help-text` | `helpText` | `string` | `''` | The checkbox's help text. If you need to display HTML, use the `help-text` slot instead. |

## Properties without an attribute

These can only be set from JavaScript: `element.prop = value`, `[prop]="value"` in Angular, `.prop=${value}` in Lit. Writing them as HTML attributes does nothing.

| Property | Type | Notes | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` |  | The default value of the form control. Primarily used for resetting the form control. |
| `validity` | — | read-only | Gets the validity state object |
| `validationMessage` | — | read-only | Gets the validation message |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-blur` | — | Emitted when the checkbox loses focus. |
| `sl-change` | — | Emitted when the checked state changes. |
| `sl-focus` | — | Emitted when the checkbox gains focus. |
| `sl-input` | — | Emitted when the checkbox receives input. |
| `sl-invalid` | — | Emitted when the form control has been checked for validity and its constraints aren't satisfied. |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `click()` | Simulates a click on the checkbox. |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions)` | Sets focus on the checkbox. |
| `blur()` | Removes focus from the checkbox. |
| `checkValidity()` | Checks for validity but does not show a validation message. Returns `true` when valid and `false` when invalid. |
| `getForm()` | Gets the associated form, if one exists. |
| `reportValidity()` | Checks for validity and shows the browser's validation message if the control is invalid. |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string)` | Sets a custom validation message. The value provided will be shown to the user when the form is submitted. To clear the custom validation message, call this method with an empty string. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The checkbox's label. |
| `help-text` | Text that describes how to use the checkbox. Alternatively, you can use the `help-text` attribute. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `control` | The square container that wraps the checkbox's checked state. |
| `control--checked` | Matches the control part when the checkbox is checked. |
| `control--indeterminate` | Matches the control part when the checkbox is indeterminate. |
| `checked-icon` | The checked icon, an `<sl-icon>` element. |
| `indeterminate-icon` | The indeterminate icon, an `<sl-icon>` element. |
| `label` | The container that wraps the checkbox's label. |
| `form-control-help-text` | The help text's wrapper. |

## Documentation and examples

```html
<sl-checkbox>Checkbox</sl-checkbox>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/checkbox/checkbox.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-checkbox-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `<sl-checkbox>Checkbox</sl-checkbox>`
})
export class CheckboxExampleComponent {}
```

> **Tip:** This component works with standard `<form>` elements. Please refer to the section on form controls to learn more about form submission and client-side validation.
## Examples

### Checked

Use the `checked` attribute to activate the checkbox.

```html
<sl-checkbox checked>Checked</sl-checkbox>
```

### Indeterminate

Use the `indeterminate` attribute to make the checkbox indeterminate.

```html
<sl-checkbox indeterminate>Indeterminate</sl-checkbox>
```

### Disabled

Use the `disabled` attribute to disable the checkbox.

```html
<sl-checkbox disabled>Disabled</sl-checkbox>
```

### Sizes

Use the `size` attribute to change a checkbox's size.

```html
<sl-checkbox size="small">Small</sl-checkbox>
<br />
<sl-checkbox size="medium">Medium</sl-checkbox>
<br />
<sl-checkbox size="large">Large</sl-checkbox>
```

### Help Text

Add descriptive help text to a switch with the `help-text` attribute. For help texts that contain HTML, use the `help-text` slot instead.

```html
<sl-checkbox help-text="What should the user know about the checkbox?">Label</sl-checkbox>
```

### Custom Validity

Use the `setCustomValidity()` method to set a custom validation message. This will prevent the form from submitting and make the browser display the error message you provide. To clear the error, call this function with an empty string.

```html
<form class="custom-validity">
  <sl-checkbox>Check me</sl-checkbox>
  <br />
  <sl-button type="submit" variant="primary" style="margin-top: 1rem;">Submit</sl-button>
</form>
<script>
  const form = document.querySelector('.custom-validity');
  const checkbox = form.querySelector('sl-checkbox');
  const errorMessage = `Don't forget to check me!`;

  // Set initial validity as soon as the element is defined
  customElements.whenDefined('sl-checkbox').then(async () => {
    await checkbox.updateComplete;
    checkbox.setCustomValidity(errorMessage);
  });

  // Update validity on change
  checkbox.addEventListener('sl-change', () => {
    checkbox.setCustomValidity(checkbox.checked ? '' : errorMessage);
  });

  // Handle submit
  form.addEventListener('submit', event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    alert('All fields are valid!');
  });
</script>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/button/button.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/checkbox/checkbox.js';
import { afterNextRender, ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA, ElementRef, viewChild } from '@angular/core';
import type SlCheckbox from '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/checkbox/checkbox.component.js';

const ERROR_MESSAGE = `Don't forget to check me!`;

@Component({
  selector: 'app-checkbox-custom-validity-example',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <form (submit)="onSubmit($event)">
      <sl-checkbox #checkbox (sl-change)="syncValidity()">Check me</sl-checkbox>
      <br />
      <sl-button type="submit" variant="primary" style="margin-top: 1rem;">Submit</sl-button>
    </form>
  `
})
export class CheckboxCustomValidityExampleComponent {
  private readonly checkbox = viewChild.required<ElementRef<SlCheckbox>>('checkbox');

  constructor() {
    // The element has to be upgraded and rendered before its validity can be set.
    afterNextRender(async () => {
      await this.checkbox().nativeElement.updateComplete;
      this.syncValidity();
    });
  }

  syncValidity() {
    const checkbox = this.checkbox().nativeElement;
    checkbox.setCustomValidity(checkbox.checked ? '' : ERROR_MESSAGE);
  }

  onSubmit(event: Event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    alert('All fields are valid!');
  }
}
```
